versions.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation
L7b quality fix - VAGUE_TASK cleared, input/output sections added

Initial release — provides essential Slack message management tools for individuals.

- Send messages to specified channels or users via Slack Bot Token authentication.
- Reply to thread messages, preserving conversation context.
- Search messages and files across the workspace for efficient information retrieval.
- List all public channels to assist with channel selection.
- Supports basic input and output formats, with clear usage instructions and error handling guidance.
